The noise map is a resource of its own. It shares modules with the particle map, which is the point of cutting maps into modules at all, but the two are planned and assembled apart, so these views hold the noise network only and the ExposomeMap views hold the particle one. A module used by both (the NADPH oxidase, vascular inflammation) is drawn in both sets of views, with the same declarations.

Each rectangle is a whole module (the SBGN submap glyph, which stands for a pathway drawn elsewhere), and each molecule between two rectangles is an interface: a molecule one module declares as its output and another declares as its input. The arrow runs from the module that makes the molecule, the plain line into the module that takes it. One molecule taken by two modules is drawn once, with a line to each. The views are built from the modules' declarations, so they change when a module's inputs or outputs change.

The overview is what the seven built modules connect through today: the two stress arms meet at the vessel, the oxidase module hands the holoenzyme to the vessel, the brain and the heart, and vascular inflammation hands the nuclear dimer to the heart.

Open sockets and plugs is the same network with what is missing at its edges. A socket, white on a dashed line entering a module, is an input the module expects from another module that no module of this resource provides. A plug, white on a dashed line leaving a module, is an output no module takes. The plugs are the more interesting half here: four modules make superoxide and nothing consumes it, and the night module makes the dismutase that would consume it, so the two ends of the same missing reaction are both already drawn.

The planned noise resource is a proposal. Modules with a folder are filled, candidates are white, and an interface not yet declared by both modules is white on dashed lines. The candidates were collected by asking what the network needs to work as a network, then ranked against the noise literature in three passes with every reference verified: which are measured under noise with a perturbation, which are measured under noise, and which are general physiology the field assumes. Each candidate rectangle carries its rank, how strong its evidence is, why it is proposed and its references, in the panel on the right. Candidates that the literature pass dropped, and claims the field asserts without an experiment behind them, are listed in the planning file rather than drawn.
